title: new bug warns when its repro matches a word of the bug's own title, which an output listing open items echoes
goal: backlog.py new bug and set --repro print a warning when a quoted literal the repro tests for in a tool's output is also a word of the item's own title, since a status or panel output that lists open items prints the title and the repro then fails on its own echo

run: import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();open(d+"/backlog.json","w").write(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items"}));os.makedirs(d+"/items");r=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,"new","bug","--title","panel says zzecho","--repro","python3 -c \"import sys;o=chr(122)*2+chr(101)+chr(99)+chr(104)+chr(111);sys.exit(1 if \x27zzecho\x27 in o else 0)\""],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr);sys.exit(0 if "own title" in r.stdout+r.stderr else 1)

notes: SP-yjfiemha retrospective, 2026-10-19: BG-jemfbkjs's repro failed on the word timeout in kbmon --status sprints' stdout after the fix, because the open bug's own title ended '(timeout)' and the output's next and left lines print it; the orchestrator reworded the title on the worker's branch and on the main branch (the panel reads origin/main's items). The touches name bl_plan.py as a guess: run referrers for the repro-warning code at planning. The check's planted repro is a placeholder.
